Q5217.reason: The confirmation was expressly conditional on the loading charge, making it a counteroffer under UCC 2-207, so no contract without assent.

Q6156.reason: The company had opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine the engineer in the prior deposition, so former testimony applies.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the ECtHR held state immunity did not breach the fair trial right, so immunity prevailed.
